answer: Each identity posts a bond sized to the compute it burned last epoch, and the bond lapses unless fresh work renews it. Replay of a submitted hash flags copies, so one hand-written quill cannot be spread across a thousand labels. Holding 1,000 seats costs 1,000 live bonds plus 1,000 distinct outputs, a fixed shale of cost under every seat. Honest work never climbs to that zenith of spend.
